  <script>
  window.UserCountryResolver = class {
  constructor() {
    this.endpoint = '/ajax/user_c_info';
    this.cookieName = '_y8_uci';
    this.cookieExpiration = 7;
    this.cookieDomain = '.' + this.domain;
  }

  resolve(force) {
    if (this.country && !force) {
      return Promise.resolve(this.countryInfo(this.country));
    }

    return this.fetch().then((data) => {
      if (!Array.isArray(data) || !data.length) {
        return Promise.reject(new Error('UCR failed: no data from server'));
      }

      const value = data.reverse().map(c => String.fromCharCode(c)).join('');
      this.setCookie(value);
      return this.countryInfo(value);
    });
  }

  countryInfo(isoAlpha2) {
    return {
      code: isoAlpha2,
      name: window.CountryCodes ? window.CountryCodes[isoAlpha2] : null
    };
  }

  setCookie(value) {
    const expires = new Date();
    expires.setDate(expires.getDate() + this.cookieExpiration);
    document.cookie = this.cookieName + '=' + value + '; path=/; domain=' + this.cookieDomain + '; expires=' + expires.toUTCString();
  }

  get country() {
    const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|; )' + this.cookieName + '=([A-Z]{2})'));
    return match ? match[1] : null;
  }

  get domain() {
    return window.location.hostname.split('.').slice(-2).join('.');
  }

  fetch() {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3000);

    return fetch(this.endpoint, {
      method: 'GET',
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      headers: {
        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
      },
      signal: controller.signal
    })
    .then((response) => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
      }
      return response.json();
    })
    .catch((err) => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      throw err;
    });
  }
};

</script>

<script>
    (function () {
        var TRACKING_API = 'https://account.y8.com/api/v1/json/tracking/';
        var SUBDOMAIN = 'www';
        var COOKIE_DOMAIN = 'y8.com';
        var SHARED_VISITOR_ID = true;
        // Only ever written when the shared id above is out of reach — one id per
        // skin, since each skin has its own registrable domain. Named for the
        // domain rather than the skin because the cookie is scoped by the former,
        // and the name is read by developers debugging their own games. The SDK
        // has a weaker `y8_vid_origin` again, scoped to a single game origin.
        var FALLBACK_COOKIE = 'y8_vid_site';

        var visitorId = null;
        var visitorReady = null;

        // Started on the first ask rather than on page load: this partial is in
        // the head of every page, and most of them never host a game. The SDK
        // waits for the id on its own schedule, so there is nothing to gain by
        // looking it up before anyone has asked.
        function ensureVisitorId() {
            if (!visitorReady) visitorReady = resolveVisitorId();
            return visitorReady;
        }

        // The id the tracking pipeline counts unique players by. Its canonical copy
        // is a host-scoped cookie on the account server, which is where the old SDK
        // has always kept it — so a game that migrates to the new SDK goes on
        // counting the same person, and a player who plays one game on each SDK is
        // still one player. That cookie cannot be read from here, but the account
        // server is same-site with the y8 skins, so a credentialed fetch returns it.
        function resolveVisitorId() {
            if (!SHARED_VISITOR_ID || typeof fetch !== 'function') {
                visitorId = firstPartyId();
                return Promise.resolve();
            }

            return fetch(TRACKING_API + 'get_uuid', {credentials: 'include'})
                .then(function (response) { return response.json(); })
                .then(function (data) {
                    if (data && data.uuid) {
                        visitorId = data.uuid;
                        return;
                    }

                    // Nobody has issued this visitor an id yet. Write it where the
                    // old SDK looks too, so both SDKs agree on them from here on.
                    visitorId = mint();
                    return fetch(TRACKING_API + 'set_uuid', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        credentials: 'include',
                        body: new URLSearchParams({uuid: visitorId})
                    });
                })
                .catch(function () {
                    visitorId = firstPartyId();
                });
        }

        // Used where the shared id is out of reach: skins off y8.com, and browsers
        // that withhold the cookie anyway. Unique players stays honest within this
        // site, and someone who also plays on y8.com counts once per site — far
        // better than the alternative, where the tracking server mints an id per
        // event and every player looks unique.
        function firstPartyId() {
            var match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)y8_vid_site=([^;]*)/);
            if (match && match[1]) return decodeURIComponent(match[1]);

            var id = mint();
            var cookie = FALLBACK_COOKIE + '=' + encodeURIComponent(id) +
                '; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax';
            if (COOKIE_DOMAIN) cookie += '; domain=.' + COOKIE_DOMAIN;
            if (location.protocol === 'https:') cookie += '; Secure';
            document.cookie = cookie;
            return id;
        }

        function mint() {
            if (window.crypto && window.crypto.randomUUID) return window.crypto.randomUUID();
            return 'y8-' + Date.now().toString(36) + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 12);
        }

        window.addEventListener('message', function (event) {
            if (!event.data || event.data.type !== 'y8sdk:platform:request' || !event.source) return;
            var source = event.source;

            // Off-y8 skins resolve synchronously here, so their id makes the
            // first reply and needs no follow-up at all.
            ensureVisitorId();

            // Answered at once. The SDK builds its leaderboard URLs from this
            // subdomain and stops listening 500ms after asking, so this reply must
            // never wait on the visitor lookup. `visitorPending` tells it an id is
            // still coming; a platform too old to send either field is simply not
            // waited for.
            source.postMessage({
                type: 'y8sdk:platform:response',
                hostname: window.location.hostname,
                subdomain: SUBDOMAIN,
                uuid: visitorId,
                visitorPending: visitorId === null
            }, '*');

            if (visitorId !== null) return;

            visitorReady.then(function () {
                source.postMessage({type: 'y8sdk:visitor:response', uuid: visitorId}, '*');
            });
        });
    })();
</script>
